idCitation.otherCitDet: Historic well location data provided by National Energy Board in tabular format. Entered into GIS by Yukon Government Oil & Gas Management Branch.

citRespParty.rpOrgName: Oil, Gas and Mineral Resources – Government of Yukon

dataIdInfo.idAbs:
Point location of all historic and active oil and gas wells in the Yukon. This file includes unique identifier, region, classification, status, well name, date drilled, related company and product.

Distributed from GeoYukon by the Government of Yukon. Discover more digital map data and interactive maps from Yukon’s digital map data collection.

For more information: geomatics.help@yukon.ca
dataIdInfo.idPurp: Intended to depict the APPROXIMATE location of oil and gas wells in the Yukon.

LegConsts.useLimit: The Government of the Yukon accepts no liability for the distribution or use of this data set.

report.measDesc: Locations provided by National Energy Board and confirmed by Oil & Gas Branch field inspections. Unsubstantiated reports of so-called ""ghost wells"" have been made. These are unlikely to exist, as all historic oil and gas wells required licensing by NEB and all new oil and gas wells require licensing by YTG Oil & Gas Resources Branch.
